name: Temporis — Advanced — Hall of Hades' Court

system.description: A Master-level power. The vampire spends one Blood Trait per hour of normal time to be affected and succeeds at a Static Physical Challenge (retest with Occult); each Trait risked shifts the time-dilation effect one step, speeding or slowing time within a single enclosed structure no larger than a high school gymnasium, for herself and all occupants.
